confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on aggregator averages (Combien Coute, Wohin-und-wann, Numbeo-style data) from 2026 and undated pages, converted at about 0.28 USD per PLN from a May 2026 Wroclaw Guide rate. Cocktail anchors use one dated Expatistan club figure (34 PLN, Sept 2025) and undated guides (30-50 PLN). The wine_glass anchor has no direct Wroclaw restaurant price; it is set from the local beer relationship (about 1.3x a draft beer) and a bottle-price proxy, which is a weak basis. Dorm, private-room, and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season window. They were not checked against live booking pages or current listings, and no accommodation searches were run. FX uses the RBA 15 October 2026 4pm rate; the 16 October value was not used because it appeared only as a provisional table snippet.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Polish city. Wroclaw restaurant prices are roughly 12% below Warsaw per one comparison site, and Old Town venues run higher than the city average. Restaurant and beer anchors are cross-checked against cost-of-living aggregators for Poland and nearby Central European cities. Accommodation is benchmarked against typical summer rates for comparable Polish regional cities, from general knowledge.
